Read MST traces

Source: R/read.R
read_mst_traces.Rd

Reads an MST Traces export: the fluorescence of each capillary over time, before and while the IR laser heats it. Normalised fluorescence (Fnorm) can be recalculated from the traces with mst_fnorm().

Usage

read_mst_traces(path)

Arguments

path

Path to an .xlsx file exported from MO.Affinity Analysis, or a .moc or .nta project file.

Value

A tibble with one row per time point per capillary. Alongside the sample and measurement settings of each capillary, it has columns:

  • included: FALSE if the capillary was marked as an outlier.

  • time: time in seconds relative to the laser switching on.

  • fluorescence: fluorescence, normalised by MO.Affinity Analysis.

Concentrations are molar. Project files give some extra columns; see the Project files section of read_mst().

Examples

read_mst_traces(tidymst_example("dppr10-cy5_traces.xlsx"))
#> # A tibble: 29,415 × 16
#>    merge_set       run       capillary measured_at         capillary_type ligand
